name: Ocal Browser v9.8.04 (Stable)
body:
## 🚀 Ocal Browser v9.8.04 (Stable) — Release Notes

### 🎨 AI Settings & UI Polish
* **AI Settings Panel Refinements**: Resolved visual nesting and double-border artifacts on AI input fields (Local Service Port, API keys, model selectors).
* **Transparent Input Styling**: Updated global CSS rules to exclude desktop-specific fields, delivering clean, shadowless inputs across Light & Dark modes.
* **AI Model Switcher**: Added support for Claude Opus 4.6 (Thinking) alongside Gemini 3.8 Flash (Medium) in the AI provider configuration.

### 🖥️ Sidebar & Navigation
* **Sidebar Close Animation**: Implemented smooth closing animation for sidebar panels, matching the existing open transition.
* **Script Load Priority**: Moved critical scripts to load before first paint, eliminating brief black-corner and scrollbar flash on startup.

### ⚡ Direct GPU Driver Communication & Hardware Acceleration
* **Passthrough Command Decoder**: Directs GL and WebGL draw commands straight to the host graphics driver, bypassing Chromium's validating emulation layer.
* **Direct3D 11 ANGLE Backend**: Native Direct3D 11 driver communication on Windows for maximum stability across NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel GPUs.
* **Zero-Copy Rasterization & Buffers**: Raster threads write directly to GPU memory, eliminating intermediate CPU-to-GPU copies for fluid 60/120+ FPS compositing.

### 📦 Packaging & Installer
* Updated Inno Setup installer to v9.8.04 with certificate signing and Windows 11 DWM rounded frame integration.
